bot-pr-stuck.title: bot PRs open over 72 h without green CI

- https://github.com/88plug/k3d-gpu/pull/350 chore(hf-console-fallback): hf-gemma4-26b-int4-ov 7b3cbc98e24a9946e561f82c752ae26cd53fc660, hf-qwen3.8-27b 37561816e66b5b9153b1b64c10968c18c1e6f4a0, hf-qwen3.8-27b-int4-ov d15f4d91eccd11dd44f615ffdb539c61bf1f1e6e (`autobump/hf-console-fallback`, open since 2026-11-07T11:16:40Z): ci.yml at 48596f4552a6: pull_request action_required, workflow_dispatch failure

A PR that GITHUB_TOKEN opened or updated gets approval-held CI runs (action_required): approve them, or dispatch ci.yml on the branch.
